question: Is learning magic the process of learning to see in your mind the image of the magic you want to use? Also, even if you have a solid mental image, will the magic still not activate without the incantation? Isn’t there any other activation key?
answer: An ‘incantation’ is just the normal method to consciously hit the activation switch. Roswaal and Beatrice use magic without chanting; that’s because they’re able to press the start switch on magic without speaking. When you’ve mastered it that well, you can use magic even if you can’t speak.
